inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read current input revision, compact project summary, operation permissions and bounded page lifecycle/browser metadata.

inputRevision.description: Exact SHA-256 revision returned by the relevant inspection; never infer a revision.

limitations: Optional previousLifecycle compares page identity and connection epoch, not the cause of a reset. Never automatically replay timed-out operations; inspect input and remaining jobs before explicit restoration.
Browser version is a bounded low-entropy navigator.userAgent self-report; reduced versions are labelled and fullVersionVerified is false.
This does not return the full project or prove physical validity.
